key_phrases: economic fallout will last longer than people are currently anticipating
moderating some areas of our expense growth
decline in average price per ad was largely attributable to the reduction in advertiser demand
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is slightly negative due to the significant macroeconomic uncertainty caused by COVID-19 and the explicit warning from the CEO regarding a prolonged economic fallout. While user engagement (DAU/MAU) and ad impressions showed strong growth, pricing power was clearly weakened as average price per ad dropped by 16% due to reduced demand in key verticals like travel and auto. Management demonstrated high confidence in their long-term product roadmap (AR/VR, WhatsApp commerce) and technical moat, but provided cautious forward guidance, notably refusing to provide specific Q2 revenue guidance. Risk disclosure was high, focusing on pandemic-related economic contraction and regulatory headwinds (GDPR/CCPA). Capex enthusiasm was slightly reduced as construction efforts were deferred due to shelter-in-place orders.
